requirements.requirement: The system must render specialty match reasoning before any quality score reasoning blocks in all triage displays.
The system must display a clear pass or fail indicator derived from the triage result for each provider.
The system must group reasoning into distinct sections (specialty match and quality) based on the frontend schema defined in S1.
The system must preserve backend-provided reasoning order within each section while enforcing specialty section precedence.
The system must render a specialty match explanation even when the match is partial, including an explicit partial indicator.
The system must render a fail state explanation when a provider does not meet triage criteria.
The system must suppress or deprioritize quality score reasoning visibility when the provider fails specialty match.
The system must handle missing specialty data by rendering a fallback message indicating unavailable specialty match information.
The system must still render quality reasoning when specialty data is missing, while clearly labeling the absence of specialty evaluation.
The system must ensure that no quality score appears above or before specialty reasoning in the DOM structure.
The system must render reasoning blocks only if corresponding data exists in the API response.
The system must default to a fail indicator if triage status is missing or undefined in the response.
The system must maintain consistent ordering behavior across re-renders and state updates.
The system must not crash or throw runtime errors when reasoning arrays are empty or null.
The system must render a clear textual explanation for both pass and fail outcomes that is human-readable.
